endorsements.name: Polina Smirnova
endorsements.label: CVE-2023-28904
endorsements.description: A logic flaw leading to a RAM buffer overflow in the bootloader component of the MIB3 infotainment unit allows an attacker with physical access to the MIB3 ECU to bypass firmware signature verification and run arbitrary code in the infotainment system at boot process.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.2)

endorsements.name: Polina Smirnova
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-32056
endorsements.description:
The anti-theft protection mechanism can be bypassed by attackers due to weak response generation algorithms for the head unit. It is possible to reveal all 32 corresponding responses by sniffing CAN traffic or by pre-calculating the values, which allow to bypass the protection.

First identified on Nissan Leaf ZE1 manufactured in 2020.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 4)
